name: IDPhotoCraft
tagline: Professional ID photos — entirely on your device
description: IDPhotoCraft is a professional Android ID / passport / visa photo maker. Capture or pick a photo, detect the face, replace the background, apply country format presets, export high-quality results, and generate print sheets — all processed locally on your device. Package ID: com.mtpcode.idphotocraft.
features: On-device face detection and framing guidance
Automatic background removal and solid-color replacement
Passport, visa, and ID format presets with DPI control
Editor tools for crop, alignment, and polish
Print sheet layout for home or shop printing
Photos never uploaded by the app — processing stays on device
Free tier with Google AdMob banners
Pro unlock: yearly subscription or lifetime purchase (Google Play Billing)

notes: Initial release: capture/gallery, face detection, background tools, format presets, editor, print sheets, AdMob, and Pro IAP
